prompt: A hooded scavenger in tattered crimson and soot-stained robes crouches low beside a flaming bronze brazier, rifling through a heap of yellowed scrolls and parchments scattered on cracked flagstones. With his left hand he clutches two freshly-grabbed scrolls tight against his chest; with his right hand he flings two unwanted scrolls into the brazier, where they curl and blacken in the flames as orange embers spiral upward. The only source of light is the brazier fire, casting a warm orange glow on his greedy face. The background is a dark, smoky stone vault.

A desperate looter in a tattered crimson cloak kneels in side profile facing south-west, hunched over a pile of old scrolls and trinkets. One hand snatches two scrolls toward his chest while his other arm casts two discarded scrolls into a roaring iron fire-basin beside him; the burning scrolls blacken and shed bright embers. Soot smudges his face. The only light is the firelight, glowing crimson and amber across the scene. The background is a shadowy ruined cellar of damp grey stone.
